value.summary: Created test/logger.test.mjs using node's built-in test runner. Coverage: default level is info; messages at or above the active level are emitted via console.error; messages below the active level (debug at default info) are suppressed; setLevel('debug') re-enables debug output and setLevel rejects unknown level names; the pre-existing log(message) export still emits at the default level. Only test/logger.test.mjs was created, per the declared write target.

evidenceCandidates.statement: test/logger.test.mjs exercises emission at each level and suppression below the active level, providing the test evidence path for FEAT-001.
